title: The configurator's search and prompt field events use the record's fields with subrecords expanded
statement: For a configured search or prompt field (key part 6 Srch or Prmpt), the configurator maps the record's search keys as PeopleCode's Record object lists its fields -- subrecords expanded -- so the keys are found in PSRECFIELDDB, not PSRECFIELD (USEEDIT bit 0x0800).

observations.observation: PERSONAL_DATA's Masking configuration maps EOCC_MASK_SEARCHINIT on PERALL_SEC_SRCH.EMPLID and PERS_SRCH_GBL.EMPLID; EMPLID is not in those records' PSRECFIELD rows (it comes from a subrecord) but is in PSRECFIELDDB with the search-key bit. With PSRECFIELDDB the derivation matches the stored rows.
